display.name: CoreDNS replicas scraped
display.description: CoreDNS Pods that answered their last scrape, per cluster. The lab runs 2 per cluster.

display.name: Nodes running CoreDNS
display.description: Nodes that run a scraped CoreDNS replica, per cluster. 1 with 2 replicas means one node failure stops resolution for the cluster (CoreDNSReplicasOnOneNode); both lab clusters run both on the control plane.

display.name: SERVFAIL share, 5 minutes
display.description: SERVFAIL answers as a share of all answers, per cluster. Normal: 0 %. Above 1 % for 5 minutes: CoreDNSServfailHigh.

spec.query: (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)

display.name: NXDOMAIN share, 5 minutes
display.description: NXDOMAIN answers as a share of all answers, per cluster. High is normal: each lookup of a short name tries the search domains first. On 2026-10-25 a cmtc-a replica had answered 107020 NXDOMAIN and 59271 NOERROR. Recorded, not alerted.

spec.query: (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="NXDOMAIN", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="NXDOMAIN", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)

display.name: Answers per second
display.description: Answers CoreDNS sent, all response codes, per cluster, 5 minute rate.

display.name: Requests per second
display.description: Requests CoreDNS received, all record types and transports, per cluster, 5 minute rate. It equals answers per second when every request is answered.

display.name: Answers in the last hour, by response code
display.description: Answers by response code over the last hour. A code appears once CoreDNS first sent it.

display.name: Requests in the last hour, by record type and transport
display.description: Requests by record type (A, AAAA, SRV, other) and transport (udp, tcp) over the last hour.

spec.text: CoreDNS's own view: the queries that reached it. NXDOMAIN dominates by design; SERVFAIL is the error signal.

display.name: Answer time, median, seconds
display.description: Median time CoreDNS took to answer, per cluster, from its histogram over 5 minutes (buckets from 0.25 ms). No value when nothing was answered.

display.name: Answer time, 99th percentile, seconds
display.description: 99th percentile answer time, per cluster, 5 minutes. The latency objective is 99 % within 64 ms (docs/METRICS_AND_SLOS.md).

display.name: Each CoreDNS replica, now
display.description: One row per replica over the last 5 minutes: answers per second, median and 99th percentile answer time, SERVFAIL per second, cache hit share, CPU cores and resident memory. Replicas of a cluster should read alike.

spec.query: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, node, pod, le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="coredns"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, node, pod, le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="coredns"}[5m])))
sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{job="coredns"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_cache_requests_total{job="coredns"}[5m])) > 0)

spec.text: Percentiles come from CoreDNS's buckets, not an average. A replica slower than its neighbour points at its node.

display.name: Forwarded queries per second
display.description: Queries CoreDNS forwarded to its upstream resolvers (names outside the cluster), per cluster, 5 minute rate.

display.name: Forward answer time, 99th percentile, seconds
display.description: 99th percentile time the upstream took to answer, per cluster, 5 minutes.

display.name: Forwarded answers in the last hour, by upstream and response code
display.description: Upstream answers by upstream address and response code over the last hour.

display.name: Faults in the last hour, per replica
display.description: Per replica over the last hour: forward health checks that found every upstream broken, queries refused at the forward concurrency limit, recovered panics and failed Corefile reloads. All 0 is normal; each has its own alert.

spec.text: On the lab every replica forwards to the node's resolver. SERVFAIL with healthy forwarding points at the kubernetes plugin.

display.name: Queries without an answer, share · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Share of DNS queries (UDP and TCP, to port 53 or to ztunnel's DNS proxy on 15053) sent by enrolled Pods that got no answer, per cluster, 5 minute rate, measured at the client's own node. CoreDNS cannot see a query dropped before it. UDP retries count as queries.

spec.query: clamp_min(1 - ((sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)), 0)

clamp_min(1 - ((sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)), 0)

display.name: Client-side answer time, 99th percentile, seconds · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Time from an enrolled Pod's query to its answer, as the client's node measures it, per cluster, 5 minutes. Includes the network path CoreDNS cannot see.

display.name: Namespaces whose queries got no answer, last minute · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Nodes and namespaces where enrolled Pods sent queries and received no answer in the last minute: the condition of CMTCEnrolledPodDNSUnanswered. Labels stop at the namespace: per-Pod detail never goes into a metric label (ADR-005). The plane's namespace label reads exported_namespace here, because the scrape sets namespace to the node agent's own.

spec.query: sum by (cluster, node, exported_namespace) (increase(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc"}[1m])) > 0 unless on (cluster, node, exported_namespace) sum by (cluster, node, exported_namespace) (increase(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc"}[1m])) > 0

display.name: Measurement plane ready, per node · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Whether the measurement plane on each node is attached and fresh. Not ready means the panels above are unavailable for that node, not zero.

spec.text: The 2026-10-25 failure: an enrolled Pod's queries were dropped at its own node's egress gate while CoreDNS stayed healthy. Only this client side shows it.

display.name: Packets dropped for policy per second, egress
display.description: Packets the Cilium datapath dropped leaving a Pod with reason Policy denied, per cluster, 5 minute rate. The 2026-10-25 DNS drops were of this kind; the counter cannot tell DNS from other traffic.

spec.query: sum by (cluster) (rate(cilium_drop_count_total{job="cilium-native", direction="EGRESS", reason="Policy denied", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster) (rate(cilium_drop_count_total{job="cilium-native", direction="EGRESS", reason="Policy denied", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))

display.name: Packets forwarded per second
display.description: Packets the Cilium datapath forwarded, both directions, per cluster, 5 minute rate: the scale for the drops beside it.

display.name: Drops in the last hour, by node, direction and reason
display.description: Dropped packets by node, direction and reason over the last hour.

spec.text: Drops have no port label: a rise of egress Policy denied drops with healthy CoreDNS is a hint, the client side is the proof.
